jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-top.png" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p><p>Our Internal Communications and Employer Branding team is looking for a trainee to join us for a 3-month traineeship. jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><img src="https://www.relexsolutions.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/relex-greenhouse-banner-top.png" alt="" width="1280" style="max-width: 100%;"></p><p>We're bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy, and we know we can't shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we are committed to being at the forefront of the AI revolution and leading our customers into this new world. We keep evolving, together.</p></div>
